mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) exceeding 2% signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are not positive in at least 70% of triggered quarters, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and inflation, ultimately reducing forward S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are not negative in at least 60% of triggered months, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 1% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are not negative in at least 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are not negative in at least 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly increase in both the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a paradoxical labor market shock, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises AND PAYEMS rises in same month
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are not negative in at least 60% of triggered months, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) exceeding 2% signals weakening household demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are not negative in at least 60% of triggered quarters, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 1% signals strengthening manufacturing activity, which boosts earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are not positive in at least 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year window.
